bio: This restaurant enjoys a gorgeous location at Lake Schwerin. Inside, the atmosphere is pleasantly laid back; the decor is modern and there is an open kitchen. Out on the terrace, you can enjoy a view of the small harbour. The reasonably priced daily set menu, served at lunchtime, is a hit. In the evening, you can choose from a variety of dishes, including Königsberger Klopse (meatballs), steaks, and burgers. Only the finest regional and seasonal ingredients are used....
